name: den-wows-monorepo
description: Markhors Den - Wolves of Wall Street (Frontend & Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:dev --prefix Den-WOWS-Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Den-WOWS-Frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Den-WOWS-Backend && npm run build --prefix Den-WOWS-Frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Backend,Frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:prod --prefix Den-WOWS-Backend" "npm run start --prefix Den-WOWS-Frontend"
